mapper.select: SELECT TEM_NO , USER_ID , TEM_TITLE , TEM_CONTENT , CREATE_DATE , DELETE_DATE FROM COM_MAIL_TEM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DELETE_DATE IS NULL

SELECT M.TEM_NO , M.USER_ID , (SELECT C.COM_NAME FROM COMPANY C WHERE C.USER_ID = M.USER_ID) AS COM_NAME , (SELECT C.COM_EMAIL FROM COMPANY C WHERE C.USER_ID = M.USER_ID) AS COM_MAIL , M.TEM_TITLE , M.TEM_CONTENT , M.CREATE_DATE , M.DELETE_DATE FROM COM_MAIL_TEM M WHERE M.TEM_NO = #{temNo} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.DELETE_DATE IS NULL
